item.title: World reacts to Democrats' midterm elections victory
item.description: From Kyiv to Moscow, and Tehran to Tel Aviv, all eyes were on the Democrats big win on Wednesday, as foreign powers weigh up how a flipped Congress will impact international relations.
item.content:encoded:
From Kyiv to Moscow, and Tehran to Tel Aviv, all eyes were on the Democrats big win on Wednesday, as foreign powers weigh up how a flipped Congress will impact international relations.

(Image credit: Alex Brandon)

item.title: 6 takeaways from Democrats' big wave on election night
item.description: The magnitude of the Democrats' outcome was always a possibility, but the depth and breadth of their victories were jaw-dropping.

item.title: Review: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is superb, streamlined and safe
item.description: Nintendo's new Ocarina of Time remake enshrines its place in the gaming canon for generations to come. But despite its stupendous production values, the game left me feeling oddly bereft.
item.content:encoded:
Nintendo's new Ocarina of Time remake enshrines its place in the gaming canon for generations to come. But despite its stupendous production values, the game left me feeling oddly bereft.

item.title: Hakeem Jeffries is poised to become the first Black speaker of the House
item.description: As speaker, the New York Democrat would be second in the presidential line of succession, after the vice president. He has vowed to focus on affordability and holding the administration accountable.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: These 9 candidates for governor made history in the 2026 election
item.description: Voters on Tuesday elected the nation's first Black woman governor and the nation's first Native American woman governor.

item.title: Nevada Attorney General Aaron Ford beats GOP incumbent for governor
item.description: Democrat Aaron Ford defeated Republican Gov. Joe Lombardo. He's set to become Nevada's first Black governor.
item.content:encoded:
Democrat Aaron Ford defeated Republican Gov. Joe Lombardo. He's set to become Nevada's first Black governor.

item.title: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed defeats Republican Mike Rogers in key Michigan Senate race
item.description: El-Sayed's campaign tested how an antiestablishment candidate on the left would fare in a perennial Midwest battleground. With the win, he'll become the first Muslim American to serve in the Senate.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Republicans tried to gerrymander their way out of big congressional losses. It didn't work
item.description: Among the sweeping victories by Democrats on Tuesday were wins in several congressional districts that Republicans had redrawn explicitly to boost their party ahead of the midterms.

item.description: Jeffries, who addressed supporters after House control was called for Democrats, argued voters have sent Congress a message to end extremism and "corruption."

item.title: Troy Jackson wins Maine Senate race over Susan Collins, in big victory for Democrats
item.description: The result is a crucial victory for Democrats in their push to retake the Senate majority, flipping a seat that Collins has held for nearly 30 years.
